# A cleanup can tighten the number of EWS response messages

Entry 1496 replaces UpdateItem’s at-least count check with the shared exact-count validator, so it is a behavior change as well as cleanup. Current make_update_item_request still compares the count against item_changes.len. Treat the request/response cardinality as a per-operation contract and verify a behavior change even when the commit title calls it cleanup. No malformed server response was exercised. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.

Scope: EWS response shape.
